# window

Provides APIs to create windows, communicate with other windows and manipulate the current window.

#### Window events[Section titled “Window events”](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/namespacewindow/#window-events)

Events can be listened to using [Window.listen](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/namespacewindow/#listen):

```

import { getCurrentWindow } from "@tauri-apps/api/window";

getCurrentWindow().listen("my-window-event", ({ event, payload }) => { });

```

This package is also accessible with window.__TAURI__.window when [app.withGlobalTauri](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/config/#withglobaltauri) in tauri.conf.json is set to true.

## Remarks[Section titled “Remarks”](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/namespacewindow/#remarks)

core:window:default only enables the getters (sizes, positions, monitors, title, theme and the is* queries). Creating a window and every method that changes one needs its own permission, which each member documents, added to a capability in your app.

```
// an error happened creating the window

});

// listen to an event from the backend
```

### WindowSizeConstraints[Section titled “WindowSizeConstraints”](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/namespacewindow/#windowsizeconstraints)

Source: [https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/dev/packages/api/src/window.ts#L284](https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/dev/packages/api/src/window.ts#L284)

Inner size constraints for a window, see [Window.setSizeConstraints](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/namespacewindow/#setsizeconstraints).

Unlike [Window.setMinSize](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/namespacewindow/#setminsize) and [Window.setMaxSize](https://v2.tauri.app/reference/javascript/api/namespacewindow/#setmaxsize), each dimension is independent: you can constrain only the width and leave the height free.

All values are in logical pixels. Leave a field out (or set it to undefined) to remove that constraint.

```
import { getCurrentWindow } from '@tauri-apps/api/window';

// at least 300 logical pixels wide, height unconstrained

await getCurrentWindow().setSizeConstraints({ minWidth: 300 });

```
